finding.detail: Selected histories with zero valid numeric samples show 'Pick a signal' although a signal is already chosen. The distribution uses the generic shared empty copy. This fails to explain the numeric-only eligibility or empty returned history.
finding.fix: Keep both sections mounted and distinguish unchosen, resolved-empty and no-valid-numeric-samples using existing EmptyState/ChartContainer empty text; do not manufacture zero entropy.

architectureIssues.detail: History is hard-coded to 48 hours at line 42. /signal-entropy is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS (workspaceScope.ts:23-77), so this dated analysis has no shared header range ownership and does not consume from/to workspace bounds. Vehicle scope correctly uses the shared owner.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should establish typed explicit-bound analysis support and register this exact route only when it consumes both bounds. Preserve existing 48h default and query/cache behavior until explicit scoped integration; never add a local date picker or silently reinterpret the period.

architectureIssues.detail: Rolling timestamps are reduced to browser-local hour/minute strings with undefined locale before reaching chart/table data. Over a 48h query, different dates can share the same label; configured locale/timezone is not passed and the plotted/fallback rows lose timestamp identity.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep raw timestamp identity in derived display rows, then use existing configured date/time formatting for axes, tooltip and table; include date or disambiguating context without changing algorithm windows or SI data.

architectureIssues.detail: Bin endpoints and observed range (lines 289-290) use generic fmtNumber without unit metadata or display-only physical conversion. The catalog hook discards unit_kind. Entropy bits/fractions are dimensionless, but physical signal ranges cannot identify their unit or honor unit display preferences from this page's current inputs.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing rich signal catalog and signal-unit presentation owner where supported. Keep binning on original canonical measurements and convert only physical endpoints at the display boundary; never infer units from a name or change wire/cache measurements.

architectureIssues.detail: Observed-range copy says samples are 'in the last 48h window', while the summary correctly warns that analysis covers returned numeric samples and is not guaranteed full-window coverage (line 174). The hook is capped at 10000 and backend coverage/truncation semantics were not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Align interpretation with requested-window versus returned-sample wording and retain actual/unknown source bounds; do not claim complete coverage or invent backend completeness.

architectureIssues.detail: This entropy consumer test builds historical samples as timestamp/valueNum (lines 64-72), but SignalHistoryPoint requires ts/kind/value (api/types.ts:2670-2678) and the entropy extractor rejects rows without string ts (signalHistorySamples.ts:19-20). The mock chart and PageLayout omit real chart/source behavior. This is source evidence of fixture drift, not a test execution result.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration/test owner should migrate this consumer's fixtures to the real typed numeric signal envelope and retain assertions on nonempty actual entropy, source bounds and retained state; add rendered chart/time/empty-state coverage instead of borrowing old receipts.

dataBehavior: 48h requested history, bounded 10000-row analysis hook, standard polling, positive vehicle/nonempty signal enablement, cancellation and cache identity.
Numeric-only valid measurement extraction, ascending timestamp sorting and last-valid timestamp deduplication; no enum/string/boolean promotion.
Default 8 requested quantile bins; collapse duplicate boundaries, normalize against populated bins.
Entropy bits, effective states, dominant-state fraction and consecutive-bin change rate; preserve exact rounding/calculations.
Rolling windows of 20 samples advancing 5 samples using global bin edges; timestamp uses each window's last sample.
Unknown input yields null metric rawValue, not invented successful zero; retain nonempty history after refresh failure.
Preserve numeric formatter locale/precision, source bounds/unknown bounds, explanations and semantic dominant-bin threshold at 0.9.
Raw canonical measurements remain unchanged; only displayed physical ranges may acquire preference conversion through established owners.
mustNotRemove: All four metrics and specialist help
Both charts and accessible data rows
